findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: media_upload_link, riddle_tag_delete, riddle_get_embed_code, riddle_publish, riddle_builder_create, reference_get, project_get_settings · Private data: media_upload_link, media_delete, whoami, question_bank_create, question_bank_list, question_bank_item, palette_get, riddle_builder_validate, reference_get, stats_fetch, project_list · Public sink: media_upload_link, media_delete, riddle_tag, riddle_get, riddle_get_embed_code, riddle_publish, question_bank_get, question_bank_manage, question_bank_item, question_bank_discard_changes, question_bank_delete, riddle_builder_update, riddle_builder_validate, project_get_settings · Destructive: media_upload_link, media_delete, riddle_tag, riddle_tag_delete, riddle_get, riddle_delete, question_bank_manage, question_bank_item, question_bank_discard_changes, question_bank_delete, question_bank_get_items, question_bank_tag, palette_get, riddle_builder_create, riddle_builder_update, riddle_builder_validate, stats_fetch.

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
